title: GraphQL Admin query fails with MAX_COST_EXCEEDED even though it returns only a few records
symptoms: Query cost is 2003, which exceeds the single query max cost limit (1000).
A products query with first: 250 and nested variants(first: 100) is rejected before it runs
cause: Shopify prices a query by the most data it could return, so nested connections multiply their first values. The real result size does not matter for the up-front check.
fix: Lower first on the outer and inner connections, page the inner connection separately, or switch to a bulk operation for full exports.
apply:
query { products(first: 50) { nodes { id title variants(first: 10) { nodes { id sku } } } } }
# full catalog: bulkOperationRunQuery
affected: GraphQL Admin API, all current versions, 1000 point single query limit
